page.notFound: This team doesn't exist or no longer exists.
page.loadError: The team's page couldn't be loaded.

header.ghostTitle: Ghost team, created by the staff
header.tagInitials: Initials — this team has no tag yet

membership.dissolved: 🛑 Team disbanded — its statistics and history can still be viewed, but it can no longer be joined or managed.
membership.ghostClaimOffer: 👻 The staff is offering you this ghost team: if you accept, you become its owner, tournament history included.
membership.ghostNotice: 👻 Ghost team — created by the staff for tournaments, with no linked player. It can't be joined: only the staff can offer it to a player.
membership.invited: You've been invited to this team.
membership.requestPending: Request sent — waiting for approval by the team's management.
membership.acceptedRoleHint: An accepted player arrives with the DPS role: adjust it afterwards in the roster.
membership.leaveBody: You leave {team}'s roster. Your matches played with the team stay on your record; to come back, you'll need a new invitation or an accepted request.

members.title: Members
members.inviteHelp: Only players without a team are suggested. The player joins the team on accepting the invitation — right away if they had asked to join.
members.kickBody: {pseudo} leaves {team}'s roster immediately. Their matches played with the team still count, and a new invitation remains possible.
members.invitedJoined: {pseudo} had asked to join the team: done.
members.removed: {pseudo} is no longer part of the team.

roles.managerHelp: A manager handles members and their roles, the logo and registrations. The name, tag, description and disbanding stay with the owner.
roles.ownerNotice: The owner role can't be ticked here: transfer it from the team settings.
roles.dropsManagement: Without the manager role, you'll no longer be able to manage the team's roster.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.bodyKeepsManagement: The new owner will be able to rename, transfer and disband the team. You lose the owner role and keep your other roles — including manager: you keep managing the roster.
transfer.bodyLosesManagement: The new owner will be able to rename, transfer and disband the team. You lose the owner role and keep your other roles (DPS if you have no other): without the manager role, you no longer manage the team.
transfer.noCandidate: No other member in the team: first invite the player you want to hand it to.
transfer.lastCheck: Last check: {pseudo} will become the owner, and will be the only person able to give this role back to you.

claim.title: Offer the team to a player
claim.body: The player receives an invitation. If they accept it, {team} stops being a ghost team: they become its owner and manage its roster themselves, tournament history included. Nothing changes until they answer.
claim.help: Only players without a team are suggested: they must not belong to any other.

settings.title: Team settings
settings.ownerOnly: The team's name, tag and description are reserved for its owner.
settings.dissolved: Team disbanded. Its statistics can still be viewed.
settings.deleteBody: The name, tag, description and logo are erased, and all members are detached. The statistics and tournament history can still be viewed.
settings.name: Team name
settings.nameHelp: {min} to {max} characters, unique on the site.
settings.tagHelp: {min} to {max} letters or numbers, unique on the site — leave empty to have none.
settings.removeLogoBody: The logo is removed from the team and its file deleted: to get it back, you will have to upload it again.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP — {max} MB maximum.
settings.fileChosen: File chosen: {file} — the preview shows the kept area.
settings.logoRights: I certify that I hold the rights to this logo: the team created it, it's under a free license, or its author has authorized its use.
settings.dangerGhostHelp: Offering the team to a player invites them: if they accept, it becomes a regular team that they own.
settings.dangerHelp: To leave the team, first transfer its ownership to another member.
settings.claimPending: Offered to {pseudo} — waiting for their answer.
